scientific_integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and exact-arithmetic computational corroboration; the 1998 uniform path spread result is cited as prior work, not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: Finite metric fibres of diameter at most 2, exact path-index cross distances, equal total fibre probability, strictly positive conditional atom weights, real-valued one-Lipschitz functions and quadratic variance. Novelty assessment is literature-bounded; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Variance rigidity under balanced path-fibre refinements
